headline_marked: Over 50 [[garment workers fall ill]] in Gazipur after drinking water
headline: Over 50 garment workers fall ill in Gazipur after drinking water
summary: Workers at Dressmen Garments Ltd in Kaliakair reported dizziness and vomiting after consuming water with an unusual taste and smell.
details: At least 50 workers of a ready-made garment factory in Kaliakair, Gazipur, fell ill after drinking water this morning.
The incident occurred at Dressmen Garments Ltd in the Chandra area, with most of the affected workers being women.
Hospitalized workers reported experiencing dizziness, vomiting, and weakness shortly after starting their shift and drinking water.
Some workers claimed they noticed an unusual taste and smell in the water and tried to inform authorities, but symptoms spread rapidly across multiple floors.
Dr Sadiya Tasnim Munmun, Upazila Health and Family Planning Officer, stated that around 50 workers received treatment at the Kaliakair Upazila Health Complex by 11:00 am.
Gazipur Industrial Police Superintendent Md Amzad Hossain confirmed that police personnel were deployed to the factory to prevent potential unrest.
The source of the water contamination has not yet been verified, and factory management has not issued a statement.

Some workers claimed they noticed an unusual taste and smell in the water and tried to inform authorities, but symptoms spread rapidly across multiple floors.

Dr Sadiya Tasnim Munmun, Upazila Health and Family Planning Officer, stated that around 50 workers received treatment at the Kaliakair Upazila Health Complex by 11:00 am.

Gazipur Industrial Police Superintendent Md Amzad Hossain confirmed that police personnel were deployed to the factory to prevent potential unrest.

The source of the water contamination has not yet been verified, and factory management has not issued a statement.

headline: Khulna: Police couple arrested over torture of house help
summary: A police officer and his wife have been detained in Khulna after allegations of torturing a domestic worker.
details: A police officer and his wife were arrested in Khulna for allegedly torturing a domestic worker.
The arrests follow a case filed against the couple for the mistreatment of the house help.
Local authorities have taken the couple into custody as investigations into the extent of the abuse continue.
The case highlights ongoing concerns regarding the treatment and protection of domestic workers in the region.
